items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area, or equivalent experience or training
Experience establishing goals and workload priorities and organizing and coordinating multiple complex projects with competing deadlines
Experience using Microsoft Office suite, including calendaring using Outlook
Experience supporting senior leaders and coordinate communication with staff
Experience with UCD automated systems, such as Aggie Travel, EcoTime, and OnBase filing system
Experience using interpersonal, customer service and communication skills to interact and communicate in-person, over the phone, through electronic e-mail, etc.
Strong writing skills and experience writing, editing, and proofreading documents to respond on behalf of pharmacy leaders quickly and accurately using proper grammar, style, and format

Under the direct supervision of the Chief Pharmacy Officer, provides high-level administrative support, engages with the pharmacy leadership team to support its officers. Utilizes initiative, judgment, and discretion in researching, analyzing, and compiling necessary information to assist management in responding to a wide variety of complex issues; research issues and initiates an array of correspondence on behalf of the pharmacy leadership team; independently assumes responsibility for issues that do not require direct involvement from pharmacy supervisors and applies problem-solving techniques to resolve various situations. As primary support to pharmacy leaders, is responsive to administrative and clerical requests through verbal and/or written communication; responds to a wide variety of inquiries through interactions with staff, residents, and the public; determining priorities of meetings and resolving scheduling conflicts as needed; provides support for meetings and travel. Back up coverage for HR functions such as OnBase filing, look up, and research to respond to inquiries for staff records, as needed. #CA-DS
65% - Administrative Support
20% - Travel and Coordination
15% - Promotes and Demonstrates Excellent Customer Service
Analytical skills to anticipate or identify problems, to research and interpret data, to present analysis, and to develop solutions for resolution and implementation
Knowledge of campus-wide offices, services and contacts, and campus policies and procedures to interpret inquiries and requests to formulate appropriate action or response
Excellent attention-to-detail and organizational skills in all areas of work
Knowledge of functions and operations of an administrative office

Proven ability to handle sensitive and confidential issues that require independent judgment and discretion, maintaining strict confidentiality of sensitive, confidential and/or privileged information
Knowledge of basic financial and statistical record-keeping techniques
Computer skills to apply various programs (word processing, spreadsheets, databases, presentation software, etc.) to accomplish daily work
Knowledge of methods of collecting and organizing data and information
Professional skills to handle sensitive or difficult situations diplomatically, and to collaborate with constituents from diverse backgrounds and perspectives
Knowledge of telephone techniques and etiquette
Demonstrated ability to work as a member of a team
Ability to coordinate flow of communications between pharmacy leadership, residents, and staff
Ability to organize complex material and summarize discussions/meeting minutes
Ability to establish and maintain cooperative and effective working relationships with others
Ability to interpret, apply, and explain applicable policies and procedures
